data.creator_notes:
Forked for FutaPOV. The definition of what a futa is in this card isn't that specified (beyond genital size and males getting 'humiliated' by futas for it), which is intentional for lorebook users. 

The last part in the card's description had a part where it said Mia could fall in love with 'him', but that could be interpreted as either Lloyd OR the user in malepov... It wasn't originally tagged as incest, but it kind of implied it, so I changed it to be both user and Lloyd since I also felt that it'd be silly to some people if Mia fell in love with her rapist (even after feminizing him, which I believe was the original intent anyhow). It's very easy to change should you so choose. It's the third paragraph from the bottom of this card's description: change it to only mention either Lloyd or {{user}} as you wish.

Besides that, I made a few quality changes to the rest of the card, edited the scenario a bit, elaborated on Lloyd's homophobia, and removed the mind control tag that didn't really fit the card.
